svg.title: Valley floor at Kettlewell from 1 metre LIDAR: contours and a cross-section
svg.desc: Contour map of a 1.2 by 0.9 kilometre area at Kettlewell built from 1 metre Environment Agency LIDAR, with one-metre contours on the valley floor, five-metre contours on the valley sides, and a terrain cross-section through the river level gauge.
svg.text: Valley floor at Kettlewell, from 1 m LIDAR
Cross-section A to B through the gauge (metres above Ordnance Datum)
Contours and section derived by Beck & Call Digital from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m).
